summary: The faulty change is cfg-2207 at 09:52, an automated cost-optimisation profile that shrank portfolio-service's DB connection pool from 50 to 5. With steady ~565 req/s the 5-connection pool immediately saturated (db_pool_in_use pinned at exactly 5, HikariPool total=5/active=5/idle=0 with waiting queues up to 57 and 3000ms acquire timeouts). This drove portfolio-service p99 from ~180ms to ~4.1s and 5xx to ~22%, which surfaced at api-gateway as upstream 504 timeouts on /v1/portfolio/holdings (gateway p99 ~4.3s, 5xx ~7%). The reporter's suspicion of the 08:00 gateway HTTP/2 deployment is not supported: it preceded onset by ~1h50m, gateway CPU/memory stayed flat, and no gateway-internal errors appeared. Root-cause category: config_change; fault origin: portfolio-service.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Config change cfg-2207 capped portfolio-service's DB pool at 5, exhausting it
ranked_hypotheses.statement: At 09:52 an automated cost-optimisation profile 'small' set portfolio-service db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5. With steady ~565 req/s, only 5 DB connections cannot serve concurrent /v1/portfolio/holdings requests; HikariPool queues (waiting up to 57) and requests fail after the 3000ms acquisition timeout, raising portfolio-service latency/5xx and propagating upstream timeouts to api-gateway as 504s.

causal_chain.claim: db_pool_in_use falls to a hard ceiling of 5 from 10:00 onward
HikariPool exhausts: total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting 25-57; acquire timeouts at 3000ms
portfolio-service p99 180ms -> 3031ms and error_rate 0.2% -> 13.5%/22% at the 09:50 bucket
api-gateway logs upstream 504 timeouts to portfolio-service starting 09:53:53

assumptions: db.pool.max_size=5 is the effective runtime pool size for this HikariPool-1 datasource
no other component changed simultaneously (no deployments in window other than dep-5220)

ranked_hypotheses.title: api-gateway dep-5220 (HTTP/2 upgrade) caused the timeouts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The reporter suspects the 08:00 envoy/HTTP-2 gateway upgrade. However onset is at 09:50-09:53, ~1h50m after the deploy, gateway CPU/memory are flat, and the failing slogans point to portfolio-service pool exhaustion, not gateway-side faults.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Deploy at 08:00 precedes onset by ~1h50m with no symptoms in between; gateway CPU/memory flat; no gateway-side error messages; root symptom (HikariPool total=5) matches cfg-2207 exactly.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Backing dependency (ledger-db / market-data) failure stalled portfolio queries
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream datastore failure could stall portfolio-service requests. But the error is a client-side pool acquisition timeout (HikariPool total=5, active=5), not DB query timeouts; latency onset coincides with the pool-size change, and no dependency error logs appear.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: No ledger-db/market-data error evidence; failure mode is local pool exhaustion with a pool capped at 5, not downstream latency; onset matches cfg-2207.

facts.statement: cfg-2207 set portfolio-service db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 at 09:52:00Z.
portfolio-service db_pool_in_use was pinned at exactly 5 connections from 10:00 onward, down from ~12.
portfolio-service HikariPool exhausted with total=5, active=5, idle=0 and pending waiters from 09:54:29.
portfolio-service p99 and error_rate spiked at the 09:50 bucket coincident with the pool change.
api-gateway 504 upstream timeouts to portfolio-service began 09:53:53 and are its only new warnings.
The gateway HTTP/2 deploy predates the onset by ~1h50m with no symptoms in between.
Gateway CPU/memory and portfolio-service CPU/restarts stayed flat across the incident.
Request traffic was flat (~560-570 req/s), so there was no load surge.

assumptions: cfg-2207's max_size=5 is the effective runtime limit for the HikariPool-1 datasource
No other simultaneous change contributed; dep-5220 is the only deployment in the window
The gateway 504s are caused by, not merely correlated with, portfolio-service slowness (same error path /v1/portfolio/holdings)

timeline.event: api-gateway deploy dep-5220 (envoy 1.30, HTTP/2 to upstreams) goes live; no symptoms follow
Config change cfg-2207 reduces portfolio-service db.pool.max_size 50 -> 5
portfolio-service logs 'config change cfg-2207 applied: db.pool.max_size=5'
portfolio-service and api-gateway p99/error_rate spike in the 09:50 metric bucket
First portfolio-service 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms' error
db_pool_in_use pinned at 5; portfolio-service error_rate sustained ~22%, gateway ~7%

recommended_actions.action: Revert cfg-2207 / restore portfolio-service db.pool.max_size to 50 (or an appropriately sized value) immediately
recommended_actions.rationale: The pool cap of 5 is the direct cause of connection starvation and the 504s; restoring capacity should clear the incident.

recommended_actions.action: Add a guardrail/validation so cost-optimisation profiles cannot shrink a production datasource pool below a safe floor without review
recommended_actions.rationale: The change came from an automated 'small' profile (infra-automation) and was applied without gating.

recommended_actions.action: Add alerting on db_pool_in_use approaching max and on HikariPool waiting-queue depth
recommended_actions.rationale: Pool saturation was visible in metrics at 10:00 but only reported as a gateway symptom.

recommended_actions.action: Review the cost-optimisation profile automation and require canary + rollback for datasource tuning
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents recurrence of pool misconfiguration (matches HIST-115).

data_gaps: No direct evidence of who/what triggered infra-automation to apply the 'small' cost-optimisation profile at 09:52 (change metadata only shows author 'infra-automation').
Config-change list was for the whole fleet; not verified that no non-listed config change to ledger-db/market-data occurred.
ledger-db and market-data-service telemetry not queried directly; ruled out only by absence of downstream error logs and by error semantics.

findings.statement: Config change cfg-2207 reduced portfolio-service datasource pool max_size from 50 to 5 at 2026-03-10T09:52:00Z, and portfolio-service logged it applied at 09:52:13.
portfolio-service db_pool_in_use was ~12 connections through 09:40, then dropped and became pinned at exactly 5 (avg=5.0, max=5) from 10:00 onward.

portfolio-service began logging HikariPool exhaustion errors at 09:54:29 with the pool capped at total=5, active=5, idle=0 and waiting queues in the 25-57 range; the same 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms' errors begin at 09:53:19.

refs.quote: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 3000ms (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=43)
GET /v1/portfolio/holdings failed: could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms

findings.verification_note: 1/2 refs verified (tc-015: quote not found in tool output)

findings.statement: api-gateway began logging 'upstream timeout portfolio-service GET /v1/portfolio/holdings -> 504' at 09:53:53, immediately after the pool change; these are the only new gateway warnings in the window.
portfolio-service latency_p99 jumped from ~180ms (through 09:40) to ~3031ms at the 09:50 bucket, and error_rate from ~0.2% to 13.5% at 09:50 then ~22% sustained.
api-gateway latency_p99 jumped from ~206ms through 09:40 to ~3120ms at the 09:50 bucket, and error_rate from ~0.22% to 4.44% then ~7.2% sustained.
The only api-gateway deployment was dep-5220 (envoy filter chain / HTTP/2 to upstreams) at 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z, ~1h50m before the 09:50 onset, and it is still live with no rollback.
api-gateway CPU (mean ~42%) and memory (mean ~58%) remained flat across the whole window, including after onset.
portfolio-service request_rate was flat at ~560-570 req/s across the entire window with no surge at onset.

portfolio-service logged no WARN/ERROR timeouts before 09:53 (zero matches for 'timeout' 08:00-09:55), and api-gateway had zero warnings between its 08:00 deploy and 09:50 (only a single unrelated 08:28 retry).

refs.quote: retrying idempotent request (attempt 2) after connection reset

findings.statement: portfolio-service CPU (~36%) and restart count (0) remained flat/zero across the window.
findings.verification_note: 1/2 refs verified (tc-008: quote not found in tool output)

findings.statement: portfolio-service depends on ledger-db (shared), market-data-service and redis-cache; historical incident HIST-115 describes an identical symptom from a datasource pool size overridden by a wrong profile.
